business_summary: HIRAYAMA HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. provides engineer placement and entrusted development, and insourcing and temp staffing services in Japan, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company offers human resource services and outsourcing services. It is also involved in the contract dispatch business for manufacturing sites for manufacturing industry clients; specific labor dispatch and commission business for development design engineers; and dispatching workers overseas. In addition, the company provides on-site improvement consulting services, educational services, paid employment placement services, disability welfare services, and employment support services for foreigners. Further, it engages in manufacturing and repairing machinery and equipment; and provision of automobile maintenance, as well as elderly care services. The company was formerly known as HIRAYAMA Co., Ltd. and changed its name to HIRAYAMA HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. in March 2017. HIRAYAMA HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
